main_text.l: ¶ Erunt fortasse Critici, qui Inscriptionem a-

l.i: liam aliquam quàm aut Actorum aut Actionum
desyderent (quam tamen Inscriptionem, & in prio-
re-olim editione, & in hac posteriore sequuti su-
mus) quoniam nomen illud augustum, singulari quo-
dam ac proprio quorumdam minimè malorum homi-
num prœiudicio solis Apostolis attributum, rerum pu-
blicè gestarum publicam & popularem memoriam
potius, quàm privatæ rei ratione aliquam contineat.
Quibus Criticis ut aliquid dare, & interim institu-
ti nostri rationem etiam habere videremur,
Actiones libenter, quæ quibusq; vel rebus vel personis
accommodari possunt, inscribere maluimus.

marginalia.note: Cur Actionum titulo, inscripta sit hæc historia.

page.notes: The printed text uses a pilcrow (¶) before "Erunt", kept as printed. The left-margin note is printed as three lines with hyphens "Actio-num" and "histo-ria", written here as one note. The hyphen in "prio-re" and "homi-num" is read from the line break; the printed hyphen is faint, so it may be a line-end hyphen rather than a printed one. The ligature forms of the long s and of the ampersand are normalised to plain s and &. No doubtful words were found.
